quote: Wherever a technician is named on a card, a group header or a column header, the name is the technician's staff record name, the same name the List's Lead Technician column shows.
Keep every involved technician discoverable by name.

Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.

Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.
